localPolicies.scope: Map2 Witch PvE; other maps and PvP not restored by this stage
localPolicies.targeting: nearest live authoritative mob/boss positions within native args.size, up to native num distinct targets; no fake firing when no candidate; exact retail target ranking/num/size semantics unproven
localPolicies.placement: latest cursor at200ms release, native1000-unit clamp, valid map point outside safe polygons; illegal placement cancels without refunding accepted cooldown
localPolicies.firstFire: first burst1500ms after stove birth, then native numTime spacing; first retail-server shot timing not proved
localPolicies.flight: server impact1300ms after warning creation, aligned to source-native visual0.3+1; not claimed to be recovered retail impact logic
localPolicies.homing: select new targets each burst; committed warning point is fixed. Existing native1059 renders the captured target position. Continuous in-flight retail homing is not claimed restored
localPolicies.contact: native effectSize used as circle radius plus native target body radius; PvE mobs/bosses only; other enemies entering warning area can be hit; multiple warning areas can overlap; exact retail collision geometry unproven
localPolicies.stoveExpiry: 15/20/25seconds from args.duration instead of generic Skill.duration5000; expiry/safe-source/invalid actor removes stove; already emitted warnings follow their own lifetime unless source identity/death/hero/skin changes
localPolicies.damageSnapshot: current attack stats captured separately for each burst warning, retained for its direct hit and resulting poison; native existing damage/resistance/crit/relic pipeline with unrecovered mitigation policy
localPolicies.poisonTicks: four normal1000ms pulses, <=250ms execution grace; no lag catch-up barrage; source/target life identity; existing generic210 users not given Witch-specific damage
localPolicies.dotMath: fixed native element4 damage calculated from shot attack with explicit native60 argument, target poison resistance and existing engine; fixed dmgType3, relic modifier once, no reapplication of onHit buffs
localPolicies.dotTransaction: HP kill reward follows existing atomic progression; successful direct contacts marked, remaining ones retry250ms within1300ms-flight+1000ms deadline; poison kill failure retries a pulse without double stamina burn, bounded by expiry
localPolicies.poisonOwnership: latest Witch token replaces previous local token for native210/305; independently purified/replaced statuses stop their own portion; old token cannot remove another source status
localPolicies.stamina: native strength resource clamped at0; this does not restore every monster-skill stamina cost or PvP consumption rule
localPolicies.passive: unique owned quick-slot/current weapon UUIDs, native Weapon.attribute4, max3; only star3 and combat level>=10; multiply derived gear/talent attack by1+0.1*count, before other current support composition; retail stacking order unproven
localPolicies.inventory: proposed inventory/current selection supplied to derived stat calculation before atomic commit; failure keeps loadout/attack unchanged; NPC Witch switch applies bonus in same property response
localPolicies.lifetime: world reference, actor reference, room/map, source skin, source battle life, target actor/spawn token; no old-life damage; cleanup routed to captured old room/map instead of a new same-ID monster
localPolicies.delivery: failed pushes retry current HP/properties/210/305/401 only, not damage/stamina/kill rewards; <=250ms read-only retry,128 actor corrections per recipient; old room/world/actor/life discarded; native entity creations use normal visibility queue
localPolicies.limits: 4 pending casts+stoves,64 outstanding warnings, bounded correction actors; source passive signature avoids repeated compounding

validation.testIsolation: only the added65074001 test monster has an isolated future skill cooldown, preventing native self-heal from masking poison deltas; production monsters/configs unchanged

native team camp coloring and Windows/Cocos render remain unverified
full monster stamina economy and Witch PvP not implemented in this stage
damage/resistance and passive stacking remain reconstructed where retail server formulas are absent
